solo.name: drain succeeds when every shard keeps a replica
solo.trace:
solo check: drain succeeds when every shard keeps a replica
call: drain_node(db, node_id='A')
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT s.id FROM shards s WHERE s.id IN (SELECT r.shard_id FROM replicas r WHERE r.node_id = 'A') ORDER BY s.id FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF s -> [(1,), (2,)]
step 3   R1  SELECT 1 FROM replicas r WHERE r.node_id = 'A' AND r.active AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM replicas o WHERE o.shard_id = r.shard_id AND o.node_id <> r.node_id AND o.active) LIMIT 1 -> []
step 4   R1  UPDATE replicas SET active = false WHERE node_id = 'A' AND active -> UPDATE 2
step 5   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: every shard has at least one active replica
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT array_agg(active ORDER BY shard_id, node_id) = '{f,t,f,t}' FROM replicas
